Đặc điểm của một người giỏi hơn.

sentences.en: At least four high-flying warplanes had to take evasive action.

sentences.en: So instead of a slap on the wrist I got promoted to high-flying executive symptoms.

sentences.en: And this time, more people with high-flying lifestyles and big mortgages to match are among the unemployed.

sentences.en: They chose their high-flying ceremony after a blind date and party brought them together.

sentences.en: Plus sea urchins and crabs dropping from the beaks of high-flying gulls who swoop down to feast on them.
